messages:
Maya Chen: URGENT: PO publish failing for ACME-PO-20259 to Acme Cloud Solutions. Portal returns `billing_account_unlinked`. @Devin can you triage? Customer wants to close this by EOD.

marketplace-bot: ALERT: publish_error PO=ACME-PO-20259 code=billing_account_unlinked details='no active billing mapping for buyer_id: acme-cloud-co'

Devin Lee: On it. Do we have the portal vendor_id and which legal entity is on the signed SOW?

Maya Chen: Vendor in portal: vendor_9922. SOW signed by "Acme Cloud Solutions, Inc." billing_id: acme-cloud-co. Portal vendor shows billing_id: acme-holdings (older group).

Anita Gomez: This is the same pattern we saw last quarter when customers have parent/sub entities. Marketplace requires PO.buyer_billing_id == vendor.primary_billing_id unless an alias exists. Two options: (A) repoint PO to acme-holdings (if customer can accept invoices there) or (B) add a billing alias for acme-cloud-co on vendor_9922.

Gabe Ortiz: Quick inventory: vendor_9922 has no aliases. Marketplace Admin UI lets us add aliases but Contracts needs to confirm if alias is allowed for this customer (billing/legal). Also watch for tax/jurisdiction implications.

Devin Lee: If alias is the fastest, I can try adding it in the Admin UI. If the UI is restricted, we open MKP ticket. Customer deadline suggests we try the UI first.

Maya Chen: Customer explicitly said invoices must be addressed to acme-cloud-co (their AP cannot accept acme-holdings). Alias needed.

Gabe Ortiz: I'll pre-check by opening a support ticket and looping in Contracts so we have an audit trail in case of invoice disputes. Creating ticket now.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created MKP-4601 — subject: vendor alias request for vendor_9922 (related PO ACME-PO-20259). Assigned: marketplace-ops. https://support.marketplace.example/tickets/MKP-4601

Priya Nair: Contracts here. We can provisionally approve a temporary alias for aliasing billing accounts while legal prepares a short amendment confirming billing acceptance. We need the SOW reference and a confirmation email from the customer authorizing acme-cloud-co to receive invoices.

Maya Chen: SOW ref SOW-3492. I have an email chain from the customer's procurement approving invoices to acme-cloud-co. I'll attach to the ticket.

Devin Lee: I tried to add alias via Admin -> Vendors -> vendor_9922 -> Aliases, but the Save button is disabled for our Org role (permissions). Will escalate in ticket.

Gabe Ortiz: Marketplace-ops responded in MKP-4601: "We can apply temporary alias on request. Need contracts approval + customer email." Marking as in-progress.

marketplace-bot: MKP-4601 status: IN_PROGRESS (marketplace-ops)

Priya Nair: Confirmed — Contracts approves temporary alias contingent on customer email being attached to the ticket. Once attached, mark Contracts as approver in ticket.

Maya Chen: Email attached to MKP-4601. Please proceed. Customer is on the line waiting.

marketplace-bot: MKP-4601 update: alias acme-cloud-co -> vendor_9922 applied (temporary) by marketplace-ops. Expires in 30 days unless Contracts requests extension.

Devin Lee: Re-running PO publish now...

marketplace-bot: PO publish succeeded: ACME-PO-20259 -> PUBLISHED, external_id: ext-ACME-20259-1

Maya Chen: Awesome — customer confirmed receipt of invoice PDF. Thanks team.

Gabe Ortiz: Follow-up actions: 1) Add verification step to marketplace onboarding checklist to reconcile vendor.billing_id vs SOW.billing_id. 2) Contract to prepare short amendment template for future alias approvals. 3) Ops: consider adding alias-permission role to prevent manual escalations.

Anita Gomez: Agree on checklist and a small RBAC change. Filing items in our internal tracker.

Maya Chen: Closing loop. If Contracts wants to convert temp alias -> permanent, ping me and I'll get customer sign-off.

Priya Nair: We'll draft the amendment and follow up; for now we approve the temp alias.

marketplace-bot: MKP-4601 status: RESOLVED (alias applied, PO published)

Devin Lee: Tagging this thread in the onboarding backlog: ONB-1122.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. :party-parrot:
